**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:18704)

**Proposed mechanism:** NAA10 (HGNC:18704) —DISRUPTS→ N-terminal acetylation (GO:0006479); N-terminal acetylation (GO:0006479) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); N-terminal acetylation (GO:0006479) —LEADS_TO→ Microphthalmia (HP:0000590); N-terminal acetylation (GO:0006479) —LEADS_TO→ Global developmental delay (HP:0001263); N-terminal acetylation (GO:0006479) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250). **Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of NAA10 in these distinct rare diseases opens avenues for exploring common therapeutic targets or diagnostic approaches, particularly focusing on pathways involved in N-terminal acetylation and protein homeostasis during development.
